title: Field repository: generated handlers
summary: Writes the field repository's event code and MAXLEN constants into hash-checked DLFR regions of existing units
intro: Read this when calculated-field and field-event code, or MAXLEN constants, should come from the field repository. A region edited by hand is reported and never overwritten; everything outside the regions is kept byte for byte.

help: drag-lint repo gen-handlers   --dfm <file.dfm>[;...] [--dataset <Name>] (--repo <file> | --project <project file>) [--apply] [--dry-run] [--json]   (writes the stored event code of a form's datasets (OnCalcFields, OnGetText, OnSetText, OnValidate, OnChange) into the handlers the DFM assigns, as hash-checked DLFR regions; a region edited by hand is refused and kept; a body that reads another table ({{ALIAS.FIELD}}) is refused until its SQL is composed; needs a schema-4 repository; everything outside the regions stays byte for byte; no --apply = dry run; exit 1 a region or unit refused or not written, 2 usage)

drag-lint repo gen-maxlen     --code-dir <folder> [--table <T,...>] (--repo <file> | --project <project file>) [--apply] [--dry-run] [--json]   (writes the <TABLE>_<FIELD>_MAXLEN constants into region DLFR 2a of each interface unit i<TABLE>.pas; no --apply = dry run; exit codes as gen-handlers)

drag-lint repo renumber-regions (--code-dir <folder> | --in <file.pas>[;...]) (--repo <file> | --project <project file>) [--apply] [--dry-run] [--json]   (renames the numbered ORM region markers DB-RAD n to DLFR n, whole units only; update-orm reads both; no --apply = dry run; exit codes as gen-handlers)
